name: MK20.3 open the landing page with no walkthrough in progress
MK20.3 the picker lists every flow in flows.json, by title and duration, in order
js: await (async()=>{const doc=await (await fetch('/static/data/flows.json',{cache:'no-store'})).json();for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(document.querySelectorAll('#demo-flow-picker option').length===doc.flows.length)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}const o=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#demo-flow-picker option'));return doc.flows.length>=13 && o.length===doc.flows.length && doc.flows.every((f,i)=>o[i].value===f.id && o[i].textContent===f.title+' ('+f.duration_mins+' min)');})()

name: MK20.3 picking the au-schools flow starts THAT flow, not the default one fetched at page load
js: await (async()=>{const p=document.getElementById('demo-flow-picker');p.value='au-schools';startDemoWalkthrough(p.value);for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(FLOW&&FLOW.id==='au-schools')break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}const d=document.getElementById('demo-step-desc').textContent;return FLOW.id==='au-schools' && document.getElementById('demo-step-indicator').textContent==='Step 1 of 4' && document.getElementById('demo-step-title').textContent==='Load NSW Public Schools' && /SYNTHETIC/.test(d) && /\bINTERNAL\b/.test(d) && !/unavailable/.test(d);})()

name: MK20.3 step 1 loads the dataset and goes to /chat
MK20.3 /chat has au.schools with every row, and shows step 2 of the same flow
js: await (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(FLOW&&document.getElementById('demo-step-indicator').textContent==='Step 2 of 4')break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}const d=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('moke_dataset'));return location.pathname==='/chat' && d.id==='au.schools' && d.rows.length===30 && FLOW.id==='au-schools' && document.getElementById('demo-step-title').textContent==='What the request will carry' && /principal_name/.test(document.getElementById('demo-step-desc').textContent);})()

name: MK20.3 step 2 is performed on its own page and advances to the prompt step
MK20.3 step 3 fills the prompt (and does not send it)
MK20.3 /governance shows step 4 of the same flow, and performing it completes the flow
js: await (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(FLOW&&document.getElementById('demo-step-indicator').textContent==='Step 4 of 4')break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}const before=location.pathname==='/governance' && FLOW.id==='au-schools' && document.getElementById('demo-step-title').textContent==='Check what was disclosed';executeDemoAction();return before && sessionStorage.getItem('moke_demo_active')===null && sessionStorage.getItem('moke_demo_step')===null && document.getElementById('demo-walkthrough').style.display==='none';})()

name: MK20.3 back to the landing page
MK20.3 load the BITRE snapshot, whose flow narrates a lock on crash_id
MK20.3 the cross-domain narration is true: the schema panel locks crash_id (MK20.3b) and not state
js: await (async()=>{const lock=(n)=>{const r=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.col-row-main')).find(x=>{const c=x.querySelector('.col-name');return c&&c.textContent===n;});return r?!!r.querySelector('.col-pii-lock'):null;};for(let i=0;i<50;i++){if(lock('crash_id')!==null)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return lock('crash_id')===true && lock('state')===false;})()
